description: Four Surpass Hobby KK2845 3100KV direct drives with selectable TR8×2(P2) single-start or TR8×8(P2) four-start screws, matching twin-pin nuts and three Ø70 laser discs.
releaseRequirements: Confirm actual motor installation dimensions, allowed blind-thread engagement and free-cable routing.
Order couplings with motor bores Ø3.175, not Ø3; confirm fit on actual shafts.
Qualify reversible sensorless low-speed control, thermal duty, screw travel and braking for the load.
Assign production fits, bearing end float, sheet stiffness, journal fatigue and pin/slot wear limits.
Use matching screw and nut leads; regenerate motor travel limits for the selected 2 or 8 mm/revolution lead.
